input.summary:
Product and UI review of ~/dev/skytec-metacritic at 695f428, done as a hiring manager would. I started the app on 127.0.0.1:8813 with a copy of the proof database (10 games, including the Whisper one), the scheduler off and outbound HTTP blocked by a dead proxy. I requested every page and API endpoint (/, filters, sorts, paging, /game/{slug} and an unknown slug, /monitor, /api/games, /api/games/{slug}, /api/platforms, /api/status, /api/runs, /api/events, /healthz, /docs, static files). I also briefly ran a second copy on port 8814 with an empty database to check the empty states. I read every template plus the CSS, JS and README, checked for horizontal overflow at 375 px, and confirmed the monitor really updates live. Both servers are stopped, nothing listens on 8765, 8799, 8813 or 8814, the tree is clean, and nothing was scraped or sent to the LLM. Test count matches the README (192).

What already works: the Russian UI is clean and consistent. Light and dark themes are fine, the viewport meta is set and no page scrolls sideways at 375 px. Filters, sorting and platform-specific scores work. The method badges are honest. Limitations are stated frankly in the README.

Problems found:
- **Blocker:** the README does not deliver 2 of the 3 required results: the working service URL and the chat log with the AI.
- **Major, invented opinions:** let's play conclusions make up the blogger's opinion when the text has none. The Kingdom Hearts card is built from a no-commentary walkthrough whose captions are game dialogue plus "Heat. Heat." (YouTube's speech recognition mishearing music), yet it lists "Понравилось блогеру". Valor Mortis lists the author's mood as a pro.
- **Major, similar games:** 8 of 10 cards show no similar games.
- **Major, error pages:** errors come back as raw JSON (404 for an unknown game, English 422 for a bad page number).
- **Major, monitor:** it never shows which source each run took (New Releases, SEE ALL page N, retries), though that order is the core rule of the brief.
- **Major, README:** it has no screenshots and no short summary at the top.
- **Minor:** about 14 more items on wording, consistency and layout.

problems.where: README.md:1-11 (intro); nothing anywhere in README or docs/
problems.what: The brief's 'Результат' asks for three things: the repository, a working service and the chat log with the AI. The README has no section with the live service URL and no chat log or link to one (grep for 'переписк', 'нейросет' or 'railway.app' finds nothing). A reviewer opening the repo cannot find 2 of the 3 required results.
problems.fix: Add a '## Результат' section right after line 11 with: the GitHub link; 'Работающий сервис: https://<name>.up.railway.app (мониторинг: /monitor)'; 'Переписка с нейросетью: docs/ai-chat/' plus one paragraph on how the AI was used (research, code, review, smoke tests). The user has to deploy with the existing railway.json, export the session transcripts to docs/ai-chat/*.md with tokens and IPs scrubbed, and fill in both links before submitting.

problems.where: app/summarize.py:259-267 (LETSPLAY_SYSTEM/LETSPLAY_TASK), 280 (prompt for the description fallback), 286-294 (validate_letsplay_json); app/summarize.py:103-108 (REVIEW_SYSTEM/REVIEW_TASK); app/youtube.py:284 (NOISE); app/pipeline.py:433-447; app/templates/game.html:121-122
problems.what: The prompt always asks how the blogger rates the game, and the validator rejects empty pros and cons, so the LLM invents opinions. Kingdom Hearts Collection: the video (Ben-Gun 'Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FULL GAME') has no commentary. Its caption text is game dialogue plus 'Heat. Heat. Heat.' (YouTube's speech recognition mishearing music), and the card shows that excerpt. Yet the card says 'Автор ролика отмечает… Он ценит улучшенную производительность' and lists 'Понравилось блогеру'. Valor Mortis lists 'Позитивный настрой и энтузиазм автора' as a pro, and 'Не указаны конкретные проблемы' and 'Отсутствие подробного обзора' as cons; those describe the video, not the game. The description fallback has the same problem: 'автор ролика отмечает' written from a video description. Critic summaries have a milder form: Dragon's Dogma 2's 'Нравится' list includes 'Положительная оценка от критиков и фанатов'. A reviewer hiring an AI Automation Engineer will read this as uncontrolled hallucination.
problems.fix: Add a field '"has_opinion": true|false' to the let's play JSON. Tell the model: 'пункты только о самой игре; не пиши про автора, его настрой или полноту обзора; если в тексте нет мнения автора об игре (диалоги игры, музыка, геймплей без комментариев) — has_opinion=false и пустые списки'. Let the validator accept empty lists when has_opinion is false. In find_letsplay, treat has_opinion=false like 'no captions': record the reason 'в ролике нет комментариев блогера' and try the next candidate. Extend NOISE to drop runs of 3 or more 'Heat.' tokens. For the description source, rewrite the prompt to 'опиши, что показано в ролике, не приписывай автору мнений', and in game.html change the headings to 'По описанию ролика: плюсы/минусы' when lp.method is llm-description or description. In REVIEW_TASK add 'только свойства игры (геймплей, сюжет, графика, техника, контент, цена), не кто и как её оценил'. Add tests that use the Kingdom Hearts excerpt as a fixture.

problems.where: app/similarity.py:73 (MIN_DESC) and 123 (the condition that decides whether a match counts); app/templates/game.html:165-167
problems.what: A match only counts with the same franchise, the same developer, the exact same genre string, or a description cosine of at least 0.06. In the database 8 of 10 cards show 'Похожих игр в базе пока нет'; only Valor Mortis and Dragon's Dogma 2 link to each other. On a fresh deployment with about 20 varied new releases, the 'похожие игры' requirement will look broken on most cards.
problems.fix: Add a map of genre families, for example Action RPG / Action Adventure / Metroidvania / FPS → экшен; Tycoon / Turn-Based Strategy / RTS → стратегии; Auto Racing / Driving → гонки; Point-and-Click / Adventure → приключения. Score a family match at half the genre weight with the reason 'близкий жанр'. When the strict list is still empty and the database has at least 3 games, show the top 3 by total score under the subheading 'Ближе всего из базы (слабое сходство)', still excluding matches that share only platforms. Cover both with tests in tests/test_similarity.py.

problems.where: app/main.py:424-427 (game_view raises HTTPException for the HTML route), 451-453 (index Query validation); there is no error template
problems.what: An unknown game, /game/nope, returns raw JSON {"detail":"Игра не найдена"}. /?page=0 or /?page=abc returns an English validation dump ('Input should be greater than or equal to 1'). An unhandled error returns plain 'Internal Server Error'. Nothing gives a way back to the site, which looks unfinished in an otherwise polished Russian HTML app.
problems.fix: Add app/templates/error.html (extends base: heading, Russian explanation, '← Все игры' button). Register handlers for StarletteHTTPException, RequestValidationError and Exception: when the path does not start with /api, /docs or /openapi.json, render error.html with the right status ('Игра не найдена', 'Некорректный адрес страницы', 'Что-то пошло не так, попробуйте позже'); otherwise keep JSON. In index(), accept bad page values and clamp to 1..pages instead of returning 422. Add web tests for 404, 422 and 500 HTML.

problems.what: The order of sources is the core rule of the brief: New Releases first, then SEE ALL pages, and a new day starts over. The monitor never shows which source a run took, although runs.sources ('new-releases', 'browse:p2', 'retry') and runs.message are stored. The runs table shows only id, start, trigger, status and ok/selected, with no duration. The cursor tile says 'SEE ALL с позиции 24', which is an internal offset. The card footer shows the raw code 'источник: new-releases'.
problems.fix: Add a Jinja filter and a matching JS map: new-releases → 'New Releases', browse:pN → 'SEE ALL, стр. N', retry → 'повтор упавших'. Add columns 'Источник' and 'Длительность' (finished_at - started_at) to the runs table in both monitor.html and app.js, with runs.message as a title tooltip or second line. Change the tile text to 'New Releases пройден, дальше SEE ALL со страницы {{ offset // page_size + 1 }}' and use the same filter in the game.html footer.

problems.where: README.md:13-28 (requirements table), 125-178 (Whisper section), whole file (418 lines)
problems.what: The README is thorough but hard to skim. Requirement table cells run past 100 words (the 'Доп. 1' row is one long paragraph). There are no screenshots, so with no live URL a reviewer has to install about 430 MB of dependencies and wait several minutes before seeing any UI. Design decisions are scattered instead of collected. 55 lines of Whisper benchmarks sit in the main path.
problems.fix: Put a short summary at the top: one sentence on what it is, the links from the Результат section, and 3 screenshots in docs/screenshots/ (list with platform filter, Valor Mortis card, monitor during a run). Reduce 'Возможности' to a checklist: requirement → where to see it in the UI → module. Add '## Ключевые решения' with 5-7 bullets: JSON backend instead of HTML scraping, SQLite with migrations and a run lease, anonymous Pollinations with quote-based fallbacks, captions first and then local Whisper base, server-side rendering plus SSE. Move the STT benchmarks and force-run protection details to docs/STT.md and docs/SECURITY.md and link them.

problems.what: For Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen the card says 'На YouTube не нашлось подходящих летсплеев длиннее 10 минут'. The search already filters to videos over 20 minutes (README line 27), and the real cause is the strict title check: videos without 'Dark Arisen' in the title are rejected. For a big AAA game the message reads as false.
problems.fix: If the merged search results are non-empty but rank_candidates drops them all, write 'Летсплеи по игре есть, но ни в одном названии нет полного названия «…» — строгая проверка, чтобы не взять ролик другой части серии. Проверим снова через сутки'. Otherwise say 'длиннее 20 минут' to match the actual filter.

problems.where: app/static/app.js:63-69 (renderButton uses manual.reason); app/main.py:270-272; app/main.py:166-169 and app/static/app.js:33-37 (wait format)
problems.what: During the cooldown the button counts down every second ('Запуск через 4:31' → '3:50'), but the hint below keeps the server text with a frozen time, 'Повторный запуск возможен через 4:31…'. I confirmed in the browser that after 4 s the button had changed and the hint had not. Both formatters print only minutes:seconds, so long waits show as '1364:03'.
problems.fix: Remove the time from the server reason ('Между запусками нужна пауза N мин, чтобы не перегружать Metacritic, YouTube и LLM') and build the hint on the client as 'Можно запустить через ' + wait(left). Make fmt_wait and wait() print 'Ч:ММ:СС' once the wait is 3600 s or more.

problems.what: The live log on the public Russian monitor shows English lines and the absolute DB path ('Service started, DB /private/tmp/…/games.db (schema v4)'). /api/runs and /api/status return the 'owner' field with the machine hostname ('local-mac:76659:…'). The worker detail prints the raw trigger code ('запуск #3 (manual): выбор игр'), and line 220 lower-cases a message that can contain exception text and proper names.
problems.fix: Log only the database file name and schema version. Translate the roughly 10 run-level messages a viewer sees (run started or finished, selection, time limit, retry, scheduler next run), or rename the section to 'Технический журнал'. Drop 'owner' from API output: select explicit columns in recent_runs. Use TRIGGER_LABELS in the worker detail and remove .lower().

problems.what: Search is a substring match after casefold only, so 'dragons dogma' does not find "Dragon's Dogma 2" and 'warhammer 40000' does not find 'Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2'. Both are natural queries, and a reviewer gets 'Ничего не найдено'.
problems.fix: In search_key, remove apostrophes, commas and periods without inserting spaces (re.sub(r"['’.,]", '', s)), replace other non-word characters with a space, then collapse whitespace. Apply it to both stored titles and queries, add a migration that recomputes games.title_search, and add tests for both queries.

problems.what: The YouTube trailer fallback picked 'Kingdom Hearts III - Official Extended Trailer | E3 2018' for Kingdom Hearts Collection I ~ III. That is a different product from 8 years earlier, yet it is captioned as the most suitable trailer.
problems.fix: For trailers, keep edition words (collection, remaster, complete, definitive, edition) as required when they appear in the game title. Prefer results whose publishedTimeText is within about 1 year of the release date. If only an older or base-game trailer matches, label it 'трейлер оригинальной игры'.

problems.what: Card notes and the errors table show technical text: video ids and Python exception class names ('Расшифровка недоступна (субтитры: <id>: TranscriptsDisabled; Whisper: …)'), and step codes like 'youtube:schema'. On a cloud host, where YouTube returns RequestBlocked, every card would show this text.
problems.fix: Map exception classes to Russian phrases (TranscriptsDisabled → 'автор отключил субтитры', RequestBlocked/IpBlocked → 'YouTube не отдаёт субтитры этому серверу', NoTranscriptFound → 'субтитров нет'). Show only the phrase plus a count of videos checked, and keep ids in JSON. In the errors table, map step codes to labels ('YouTube: формат ответа изменился').

problems.what: On a 375 px screen the 4-column platforms table scrolls sideways inside its card (scrollWidth 408 vs 305), hiding Userscore counts and the release column. Rows repeat the name as a chip ('PC PC'). The hero shows the Metascore review count ('PC, 48 рецензий') but no Userscore count. The PS5 row shows '— · 1 оценка' with no explanation why there is no score.
problems.fix: At max-width 640px hide the 4th column (th:nth-child(4), td:nth-child(4) {display:none}). Render the short-name chip only when p.short != p.name. Add '{{ lead user_count }} оценок' under Userscore in the hero. Show 'мало оценок для Userscore' when user_count > 0 and userscore is none.

problems.what: A page past the end (/?page=2 with 10 games) shows 'Найдено: 10' together with 'Ничего не найдено'. 'Найдено: N' has no noun and no plural form.
problems.fix: Clamp page to the number of pages in index(), or render 'На странице N пусто, всего страниц: M' with a link to page 1. Change the counter to 'Найдено: {{ total }} {{ total|plural("игра","игры","игр") }}'.

problems.what: Empty and disabled states are misleading. With SCHEDULER_ENABLED=0 the empty index still promises an automatic first run, and the monitor still says 'запускается каждые 60 мин'. With no runs yet the cursor tile says 'сегодня ещё идёт блок New Releases', which suggests something is running. After a restart the Metacritic, YouTube and LLM worker cards show only 'ожидает —'.
problems.fix: Branch on st.config.scheduler_enabled ('Автозапуск выключен, запустите обработку кнопкой'). Use 'сегодня первым будет обработан блок New Releases' while new_releases_done is false and no run exists today. Initialise worker detail to 'с момента старта сервиса запросов не было' and optionally add the last run's finish time.

problems.what: Small visual issues. The reason chips under similar games stretch to the score badge height and look like tall pills. Long log lines do not wrap and scroll sideways on phones. At about 1100 px the force-run button wraps under the description on the left. On phones the brand reads 'MC Игры' right next to the nav item 'Игры'. The 'Обработка запущена.' banner stays after the run ends.
problems.fix: Add .similar .chips{align-items:center}, .log div{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}, .page-head>div:first-child{flex:1 1 420px} and .run-box{margin-left:auto}. Shorten the mobile brand to 'MC Дайджест'. Hide #flash in render() when running changes from true to false.

problems.what: The repo ships .env.example, but nothing loads a .env file and the README never mentions it. A reviewer who copies it to .env gets no effect.
problems.fix: Under 'Переменные окружения', state that values come only from the process environment and give the one-liner 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a' for local runs. Alternatively, have app/serve.py read ./.env into os.environ.setdefault before exec, without adding a new dependency.

problems.what: The ASCII diagram is off by one column. The right border on line 34 is at column 67 while the rest of the box is at 66. The top border of the Metacritic box on line 46 ends at column 42 while its sides are at 43. GitHub renders this as broken box lines.
problems.fix: Remove one '─'/space on line 34 before the right '│' and add one '─' to the top border on line 46. Check that every box edge sits in the same column.

toolu_01SWpexQZQD85oEXW1P2HEyp.summary:
Product and UI review of ~/dev/skytec-metacritic at 695f428, done as a hiring manager would. I started the app on 127.0.0.1:8813 with a copy of the proof database (10 games, including the Whisper one), the scheduler off and outbound HTTP blocked by a dead proxy. I requested every page and API endpoint (/, filters, sorts, paging, /game/{slug} and an unknown slug, /monitor, /api/games, /api/games/{slug}, /api/platforms, /api/status, /api/runs, /api/events, /healthz, /docs, static files). I also briefly ran a second copy on port 8814 with an empty database to check the empty states. I read every template plus the CSS, JS and README, checked for horizontal overflow at 375 px, and confirmed the monitor really updates live. Both servers are stopped, nothing listens on 8765, 8799, 8813 or 8814, the tree is clean, and nothing was scraped or sent to the LLM. Test count matches the README (192).

What already works: the Russian UI is clean and consistent. Light and dark themes are fine, the viewport meta is set and no page scrolls sideways at 375 px. Filters, sorting and platform-specific scores work. The method badges are honest. Limitations are stated frankly in the README.

Problems found:
- **Blocker:** the README does not deliver 2 of the 3 required results: the working service URL and the chat log with the AI.
- **Major, invented opinions:** let's play conclusions make up the blogger's opinion when the text has none. The Kingdom Hearts card is built from a no-commentary walkthrough whose captions are game dialogue plus "Heat. Heat." (YouTube's speech recognition mishearing music), yet it lists "Понравилось блогеру". Valor Mortis lists the author's mood as a pro.
- **Major, similar games:** 8 of 10 cards show no similar games.
- **Major, error pages:** errors come back as raw JSON (404 for an unknown game, English 422 for a bad page number).
- **Major, monitor:** it never shows which source each run took (New Releases, SEE ALL page N, retries), though that order is the core rule of the brief.
- **Major, README:** it has no screenshots and no short summary at the top.
- **Minor:** about 14 more items on wording, consistency and layout.

problems.where: README.md:1-11 (intro); nothing anywhere in README or docs/
problems.what: The brief's 'Результат' asks for three things: the repository, a working service and the chat log with the AI. The README has no section with the live service URL and no chat log or link to one (grep for 'переписк', 'нейросет' or 'railway.app' finds nothing). A reviewer opening the repo cannot find 2 of the 3 required results.
problems.fix: Add a '## Результат' section right after line 11 with: the GitHub link; 'Работающий сервис: https://<name>.up.railway.app (мониторинг: /monitor)'; 'Переписка с нейросетью: docs/ai-chat/' plus one paragraph on how the AI was used (research, code, review, smoke tests). The user has to deploy with the existing railway.json, export the session transcripts to docs/ai-chat/*.md with tokens and IPs scrubbed, and fill in both links before submitting.

problems.where: app/summarize.py:259-267 (LETSPLAY_SYSTEM/LETSPLAY_TASK), 280 (prompt for the description fallback), 286-294 (validate_letsplay_json); app/summarize.py:103-108 (REVIEW_SYSTEM/REVIEW_TASK); app/youtube.py:284 (NOISE); app/pipeline.py:433-447; app/templates/game.html:121-122
problems.what: The prompt always asks how the blogger rates the game, and the validator rejects empty pros and cons, so the LLM invents opinions. Kingdom Hearts Collection: the video (Ben-Gun 'Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FULL GAME') has no commentary. Its caption text is game dialogue plus 'Heat. Heat. Heat.' (YouTube's speech recognition mishearing music), and the card shows that excerpt. Yet the card says 'Автор ролика отмечает… Он ценит улучшенную производительность' and lists 'Понравилось блогеру'. Valor Mortis lists 'Позитивный настрой и энтузиазм автора' as a pro, and 'Не указаны конкретные проблемы' and 'Отсутствие подробного обзора' as cons; those describe the video, not the game. The description fallback has the same problem: 'автор ролика отмечает' written from a video description. Critic summaries have a milder form: Dragon's Dogma 2's 'Нравится' list includes 'Положительная оценка от критиков и фанатов'. A reviewer hiring an AI Automation Engineer will read this as uncontrolled hallucination.
problems.fix: Add a field '"has_opinion": true|false' to the let's play JSON. Tell the model: 'пункты только о самой игре; не пиши про автора, его настрой или полноту обзора; если в тексте нет мнения автора об игре (диалоги игры, музыка, геймплей без комментариев) — has_opinion=false и пустые списки'. Let the validator accept empty lists when has_opinion is false. In find_letsplay, treat has_opinion=false like 'no captions': record the reason 'в ролике нет комментариев блогера' and try the next candidate. Extend NOISE to drop runs of 3 or more 'Heat.' tokens. For the description source, rewrite the prompt to 'опиши, что показано в ролике, не приписывай автору мнений', and in game.html change the headings to 'По описанию ролика: плюсы/минусы' when lp.method is llm-description or description. In REVIEW_TASK add 'только свойства игры (геймплей, сюжет, графика, техника, контент, цена), не кто и как её оценил'. Add tests that use the Kingdom Hearts excerpt as a fixture.

problems.where: app/similarity.py:73 (MIN_DESC) and 123 (the condition that decides whether a match counts); app/templates/game.html:165-167
problems.what: A match only counts with the same franchise, the same developer, the exact same genre string, or a description cosine of at least 0.06. In the database 8 of 10 cards show 'Похожих игр в базе пока нет'; only Valor Mortis and Dragon's Dogma 2 link to each other. On a fresh deployment with about 20 varied new releases, the 'похожие игры' requirement will look broken on most cards.
problems.fix: Add a map of genre families, for example Action RPG / Action Adventure / Metroidvania / FPS → экшен; Tycoon / Turn-Based Strategy / RTS → стратегии; Auto Racing / Driving → гонки; Point-and-Click / Adventure → приключения. Score a family match at half the genre weight with the reason 'близкий жанр'. When the strict list is still empty and the database has at least 3 games, show the top 3 by total score under the subheading 'Ближе всего из базы (слабое сходство)', still excluding matches that share only platforms. Cover both with tests in tests/test_similarity.py.

problems.where: app/main.py:424-427 (game_view raises HTTPException for the HTML route), 451-453 (index Query validation); there is no error template
problems.what: An unknown game, /game/nope, returns raw JSON {"detail":"Игра не найдена"}. /?page=0 or /?page=abc returns an English validation dump ('Input should be greater than or equal to 1'). An unhandled error returns plain 'Internal Server Error'. Nothing gives a way back to the site, which looks unfinished in an otherwise polished Russian HTML app.
problems.fix: Add app/templates/error.html (extends base: heading, Russian explanation, '← Все игры' button). Register handlers for StarletteHTTPException, RequestValidationError and Exception: when the path does not start with /api, /docs or /openapi.json, render error.html with the right status ('Игра не найдена', 'Некорректный адрес страницы', 'Что-то пошло не так, попробуйте позже'); otherwise keep JSON. In index(), accept bad page values and clamp to 1..pages instead of returning 422. Add web tests for 404, 422 and 500 HTML.

problems.what: The order of sources is the core rule of the brief: New Releases first, then SEE ALL pages, and a new day starts over. The monitor never shows which source a run took, although runs.sources ('new-releases', 'browse:p2', 'retry') and runs.message are stored. The runs table shows only id, start, trigger, status and ok/selected, with no duration. The cursor tile says 'SEE ALL с позиции 24', which is an internal offset. The card footer shows the raw code 'источник: new-releases'.
problems.fix: Add a Jinja filter and a matching JS map: new-releases → 'New Releases', browse:pN → 'SEE ALL, стр. N', retry → 'повтор упавших'. Add columns 'Источник' and 'Длительность' (finished_at - started_at) to the runs table in both monitor.html and app.js, with runs.message as a title tooltip or second line. Change the tile text to 'New Releases пройден, дальше SEE ALL со страницы {{ offset // page_size + 1 }}' and use the same filter in the game.html footer.

problems.where: README.md:13-28 (requirements table), 125-178 (Whisper section), whole file (418 lines)
problems.what: The README is thorough but hard to skim. Requirement table cells run past 100 words (the 'Доп. 1' row is one long paragraph). There are no screenshots, so with no live URL a reviewer has to install about 430 MB of dependencies and wait several minutes before seeing any UI. Design decisions are scattered instead of collected. 55 lines of Whisper benchmarks sit in the main path.
problems.fix: Put a short summary at the top: one sentence on what it is, the links from the Результат section, and 3 screenshots in docs/screenshots/ (list with platform filter, Valor Mortis card, monitor during a run). Reduce 'Возможности' to a checklist: requirement → where to see it in the UI → module. Add '## Ключевые решения' with 5-7 bullets: JSON backend instead of HTML scraping, SQLite with migrations and a run lease, anonymous Pollinations with quote-based fallbacks, captions first and then local Whisper base, server-side rendering plus SSE. Move the STT benchmarks and force-run protection details to docs/STT.md and docs/SECURITY.md and link them.

problems.what: For Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen the card says 'На YouTube не нашлось подходящих летсплеев длиннее 10 минут'. The search already filters to videos over 20 minutes (README line 27), and the real cause is the strict title check: videos without 'Dark Arisen' in the title are rejected. For a big AAA game the message reads as false.
problems.fix: If the merged search results are non-empty but rank_candidates drops them all, write 'Летсплеи по игре есть, но ни в одном названии нет полного названия «…» — строгая проверка, чтобы не взять ролик другой части серии. Проверим снова через сутки'. Otherwise say 'длиннее 20 минут' to match the actual filter.

problems.where: app/static/app.js:63-69 (renderButton uses manual.reason); app/main.py:270-272; app/main.py:166-169 and app/static/app.js:33-37 (wait format)
problems.what: During the cooldown the button counts down every second ('Запуск через 4:31' → '3:50'), but the hint below keeps the server text with a frozen time, 'Повторный запуск возможен через 4:31…'. I confirmed in the browser that after 4 s the button had changed and the hint had not. Both formatters print only minutes:seconds, so long waits show as '1364:03'.
problems.fix: Remove the time from the server reason ('Между запусками нужна пауза N мин, чтобы не перегружать Metacritic, YouTube и LLM') and build the hint on the client as 'Можно запустить через ' + wait(left). Make fmt_wait and wait() print 'Ч:ММ:СС' once the wait is 3600 s or more.

problems.what: The live log on the public Russian monitor shows English lines and the absolute DB path ('Service started, DB /private/tmp/…/games.db (schema v4)'). /api/runs and /api/status return the 'owner' field with the machine hostname ('local-mac:76659:…'). The worker detail prints the raw trigger code ('запуск #3 (manual): выбор игр'), and line 220 lower-cases a message that can contain exception text and proper names.
problems.fix: Log only the database file name and schema version. Translate the roughly 10 run-level messages a viewer sees (run started or finished, selection, time limit, retry, scheduler next run), or rename the section to 'Технический журнал'. Drop 'owner' from API output: select explicit columns in recent_runs. Use TRIGGER_LABELS in the worker detail and remove .lower().

problems.what: Search is a substring match after casefold only, so 'dragons dogma' does not find "Dragon's Dogma 2" and 'warhammer 40000' does not find 'Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2'. Both are natural queries, and a reviewer gets 'Ничего не найдено'.
